text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... ...To think they'd be this 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's only one reason I was able to beat 
you this time. It's because I got to face 
the you of right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...According to historical records, no 
Classic-class Umamusume has ever won the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because for an Umamusume, this period is a 
time of growth. And that applies to you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I clearly held an 
advantage. I don't want to write that off 
as a mere difference in raw ability.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I want to compete with you 
again one year from now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes... it will truly be a 
day where I can say I defeated you with no 
reservations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Look at that smug face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't you run away. Next time, I'll 
overtake you for sure."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I won't run away. After all, I am 
the one challenging you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And when that time comes, chase after my 
back once again.
